title: Connect your Trezor

steps.unlockDevice: Unlock with your PIN on the device

accessDenied: Could not access the Trezor. Check USB permissions (Linux: udev rule).
notInitialized: This Trezor isn't set up yet. Set it up in Trezor Suite first, then try again.
connectTimeout: Trezor did not respond in time. Make sure it's unlocked, then try again.
